mapper.select: SELECT VMVT.TMP_CODE tmpCode, VMVT.TMP_NAME tmpName, VMVT.BUSI_TYPE busiType, VMVT.REMARK remark, VMVT.CREATE_USER createUser, VMVT.RECORD_TYPE recordType FROM VAL_MANUAL_VOUCHER_TMP VMVT WHERE VMVT.TMP_CODE=#{tmpCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select DETAIL.SUBJECT_NO subjectNo, DETAIL.SUBJECT_NAME subjectName, DETAIL.CD_FLAG cdFlag, DETAIL.CCY ccy, DETAIL.O_HAPPEN_AMT oHappenAmt, CASE WHEN DETAIL.CD_FLAG ='C' THEN DETAIL.O_HAPPEN_AMT ELSE NULL END cAmt, CASE WHEN DETAIL.CD_FLAG ='D' THEN DETAIL.O_HAPPEN_AMT ELSE NULL END dAmt, DETAIL.HAPPEN_NUMBER happenNumber FROM VAL_MANUAL_VOUCHER_TMP VMVT LEFT JOIN VAL_MANUAL_VOUCHER_TMP_DETAIL DETAIL ON VMVT.TMP_CODE =DETAIL.TMP_CODE where VMVT.TMP_CODE=#{tmpCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_NO id, SUBJECT_NAME text FROM BOK_SUBJECT WHERE SUBJECT_LEVEL = #{level3}
AND (SUBJECT_NO LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR SUBJECT_NAME LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%')
SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_NO AS subjectNo, SUBJECT_NAME AS subjectName FROM BOK_SUBJECT WHERE SUBJECT_NO = #{subjectNo}

SELECT UUID uuid, TMP_CODE tmpCode, SUBJECT_NO subjectNo, SUBJECT_NAME subjectName, CD_FLAG cdFlag, CCY ccy, O_HAPPEN_AMT oHappenAmt, HAPPEN_NUMBER happenNumber, CREATE_USER createUser, CREATE_DEPT createDept, CREATE_TIME createTime, UPDATE_USER updateUser, UPDATE_TIME updateTime from VAL_MANUAL_VOUCHER_TMP_DETAIL where TMP_CODE=#{tmpCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and SUBJECT_NO=#{subjectNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
